about: I am a PhD student in Computer Science at University of Tokyo, supervised by Prof. Hideki Nakayama. I obtain my Master Degree in from Tsinghua University under the supervision of Prof. Xiaohao Wang at 2025 and Bachelor's Degree from Tianjin University at 2022, both in Dept. Electrical Engineering. I also gained exchange experience at The University of Tokyo supervised by Prof. Ken Takeuchi.

My research focuses on bridging Physics with modern Generative AI. Unlike pure deep learning approaches, I advocate for incorporating interpretable structures into the design of foundation models. My goal is to build generative systems that are not only high-quality but also physically consistent, theoretically interpretable, and computationally efficient.
